transcript_turns.speaker: Arthur Sterling (CEO)
transcript_turns.text: Good afternoon, everyone. We are thrilled to report another record quarter with consolidated revenues climbing 18.5% year-over-year to $485 million, driven by exceptional organic subscription adoption across our cloud enterprise portfolio.

transcript_turns.speaker: Arthur Sterling (CEO)
transcript_turns.text: Our gross margin expanded to 71.4%, reflecting pure pricing power and strong customer retention with negligible concession requirements or deferred billing arrangements.

transcript_turns.speaker: Claire Vance (CFO)
transcript_turns.text: Turning to the balance sheet, cash flow from operations was robust at $112 million. Total liquidity stands at an abundant $310 million in unrestricted cash and short-term treasuries.

transcript_turns.speaker: Claire Vance (CFO)
transcript_turns.text: Our debt maturity profile is completely derisked. We have no significant debt refinancing obligations or covenant pressures occurring anywhere within the next 24 months.

transcript_turns.speaker: Arthur Sterling (CEO)
transcript_turns.text: In response to Mark from Goldman Sachs: absolutely not. None of our customer contracts involve side agreements, extended payment terms beyond 30 days, or contingent hardware buyback terms. Our cash collections remain in pristine health.

transcript_turns.speaker: Claire Vance (CFO)
transcript_turns.text: Regarding our joint-venture entities in Singapore: they operate entirely autonomously as non-recourse standalone vehicles. CyberTech has zero parent guarantees or exposure to their liabilities.
